caption: The pediment of the United States Supreme Court Building, which decided Smith in 1990.
alt: Close view of the Supreme Court Building's marble pediment and Corinthian columns, with the inscription 'Equal Justice Under Law' below a sculpted frieze.
credit: Carol M. Highsmith / Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division, via Wikimedia Commons
note: No document image exists: Smith comes from a case-law database (CourtListener) as text, not a scanned opinion. This is a contextual photo of the courthouse, not a picture from the case record. Highsmith donated her entire photographic archive to the Library of Congress with no copyright restrictions.
